profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer passionate about racial and gender equality, environmental issues, and resolving conflict through actionable solutions. My goal is to change the world through my individual contributions. I have graduated with a degree in computer science, with an added interest in user experience design and linguistics. 

I want to use my education and skills to help people and businesses improve their platforms so that visitors have a great user experience. 

Please see the certification section below. 

Technologies used:
Javascript, Swift, Python, Java, C++
HTML5, CSS

Development Tools:
Xcode, Atom, Eclipse, Visual Studio Code

Code version control:
Git

Code repository:
GitHub (Visit my GitHub repositories at the link below)

Content Management:
WordPress, Squarespace, Wix, iPage

Transferable Skills
- Collaborator
- Communicator
- Supreme multi-tasker
- Excellent organizer
- Problem solver

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
Freelance web developer for businesses, nonprofits, and other organizations.

For R3 Score, made updates related to images, videos, layout updates, and formatting. As well as updated plug-ins for Wordpress to support responsive features.

For Team Mongoose, made updates related to images, videos, layout updates, and formatting. In addition, made updates for Shopify requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Shopify · E-Commerce · Software as a Service (SaaS) · C++ · Swift (Programming Language) · JSON · Python (Programming Language) · Node.js · Java · JavaScript

positions.title: Communications Manager & Software Developer
positions.description:
Black Women in Computing is a community created to provide support and resources focused on increasing the number of Black women and other underrepresented groups in computing-related fields. 

I am currently the software developer in charge of the upkeep and changes made to the website. This includes updates related to images, videos, layout, and formatting.

I am also the communications manager overseeing all communications on our social media platforms and website.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Social Media Communications · Software as a Service (SaaS) · WordPress

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
I was a software engineer intern at teleSMART health, a start-up company that wishes to provide patients with a customized kit of connected examination equipment and a smart tablet to facilitate exam communication, take measurements and allow monitoring of patient health data. 
My job is to help create the front and back end for their mobile application for an MVP, which will focus on authentication for doctors and patients, and storing their personal data via their mobile app. We are currently in the beginning phases.
positions.insights: Skills: Gitlab · Python (Programming Language) · React.js · Node.js · Express.js · Firebase · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
My first technical job as a web developer in a startup company in stealth mode. I'm very proud of how much I've accomplished in such a short time and my approach to creating products.
Worked with the founder on requirements for information and currently in progress for a more robust website.

projects.title: Cause Compass
projects.description: Donors need to capture appropriate cause with an immediate impact. Potential donors get frustrated with donation sites because they lack precision and almost always post multiple overlapping input boxes with redundant information. This discourages successful transactions. The goal is to simplify and elucidate the process. Born out of the December 2012 Random Hacks of Kindness Atlanta, CauseCompass is entirely a volunteer project dedicated to facilitating donating to charities.

projects.title: Writing Chukese
projects.description: National Day of Civic Hacking June 2013 organized by Random Hack of Kindness Atlanta. Part of project team designing a website for Peace Corps volunteers in Micronesia.  They are challenged with learning the language, Chukese, that does not have a written language.  The goal was to design a picture dictionary website that can be operational offline.
